subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should Teams lifecycle reset reuse current main's core gateway reset owner instead of publishing the branch's plugin-callable lifecycle-reset API?
rationale: The Teams plugin can own the observable removal signal while another plugin owns the locked physical runtime, so the permanent cross-plugin authorization boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Reuse core reset owner
options.body: Add a narrow core-owned request seam that resolves and releases the registered harness owner before canonical session rotation, without granting Teams cross-plugin privileges.

options.title: Sponsor a public SDK contract
options.body: Keep the public reset method only after defining, approving, documenting, and testing its permanent cross-plugin authorization and compatibility guarantees.

options.title: Accept unlocked-only behavior
options.body: Land the current design only with an explicit decision that locked harness-owned sessions may retain prior context after Teams app removal.

recommendation.title: Reuse core reset owner
recommendation.body: Add a narrow core-owned request seam that resolves and releases the registered harness owner before canonical session rotation, without granting Teams cross-plugin privileges.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned reviewer established the owner-boundary requirements and is the strongest available decision owner for the integration direction.
